fields.title: Target
fields.description: Select the numeric target column (response variable) the regression should predict.
fields.choicesNote: варианты появятся, когда к узлу подключена входная таблица

fields.title: Values
fields.description: Choose the independent variables to include in the regression model. Nominal columns are converted into dummy variables automatically, as described in Categorical variables in regression.

fields.title: Predefined offset value
fields.description:
Provide a user-defined intercept instead of estimating the constant term. When enabled, the specified offset
is used as intercept and the model does not estimate a constant.

fields.title: Offset value
fields.description: Enter the constant term used when a predefined offset is applied to the regression model.

fields.title: Missing values in input data
fields.description: Decide whether rows containing missing values should be ignored or cause the node execution to abort.

fields.title: First row
fields.description: Specify the index of the first row that is available for the scatter plot view. Counting starts at 1.

fields.title: Row count
fields.description: Define how many rows should be provided to the scatter plot view.
